name: inline-chip
title: Inline Chip
description: The one inline reference in running text — a person, page, file, task, meeting, customer or project — on the text's baseline at its size, tinted by kind; a person previews avatar, name and email on hover, the rest open on click with ⌘-click for a new tab.

meta.whenToUse: A mention or a file link inside text — an editor, a Markdown body, a comment — that should read as part of the sentence and open or preview its target.
meta.whenNotToUse: A record's property value or a picker (RecordChip), a removable token in an input (Chip), or a status label (Badge).
